mechanism: CyclePeriod: 4-bar weighted smooth → 7-tap Hilbert detrender → I1/Q1 → 90° advance to I2/Q2 → homodyne Re/Im vs prior bar → period=2π/atan(Im/Re); clamp ≤50% bar-to-bar and into [6,50] bars; double-smooth (0.2/0.8 then 0.33/0.67). Exposes Value/RawPeriod/InPhase/Quadrature/Ready for downstream adaptive modules.
data_needed: Median price (H+L)/2 bar series; warm-up ≥7 samples; full-history replay of IIR state
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD examples; EA tested EURUSD M30 real ticks 2026.03.13–2026.04.17; period band 6–50 bars
why_new_for_mis: Continuous dominant-cycle length in bars is a reproducible rhythm/regime sensor MIS can feed any adaptive window instead of fixed lookbacks.

mechanism: MAMA reuses CyclePeriod I1/Q1: phase=atan(Q1/I1), deltaPhase=prior−current (floored), alpha=FastLimit/deltaPhase clamped to [SlowLimit,FastLimit] (defaults 0.05/0.5). mama=α·price+(1−α)·mama; fama=0.5α·mama+(1−0.5α)·fama. Fast alpha in slow-phase trends, slow alpha in fast-phase congestion; MAMA/FAMA cross = direction flip.
data_needed: CyclePeriod InPhase/Quadrature; FastLimit/SlowLimit; median price stream
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD chart MAMA/FAMA plots; same M30 EA test window
why_new_for_mis: Phase-rate–driven adaptive alpha (not Kaufman efficiency) is a Hilbert-conditioned trend/chop change sensor distinct from iAMA.
quote: When the phase is changing rapidly, the alpha is made larger to produce very little smoothing. When the phase is changing slowly, alpha is made smaller for more smoothing.

mechanism: On each new closed bar, EA replays ≤1500 closed bars through MAMA+EvenBetterSinewave (no iCustom). trendMode if |EBSW|≥RailLevel (0.85): follow MAMA>FAMA direction with stop-and-reverse. Else cycle mode: fade when prior EBSW beyond ±CycleEntry (0.70) and turning back; exit mean-reversion on zero-cross. Warm-up Ready() gated; once-per-bar only.
data_needed: CopyRates closed bars from index 1; EBSW duration; RailLevel; CycleEntry; MAMA limits
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD M30; 203 trades over ~5 weeks real ticks; defaults FastLimit 0.5 SlowLimit 0.05 Duration 40

quote: the market is, at any moment, in one of two modes and only two: it is either cycling... or trending... know which mode it is in and switch playbooks accordingly.

mechanism: CandleType(shift) computes body, upperWick, lowerWick from OHLC then emits A/a (body>1.5× both wicks: long/short/marubozu), G/g (2×body < both wicks: spinning top), H/h (lowerWick>2.5×body and >2×upper: pin), E/e (upper-dominant inverted pin), D (close==open doji). Uppercase bullish / lowercase bearish pairs turn each bar into a deterministic letter.
data_needed: Per-bar OHLC; fixed body/wick ratio thresholds (1.5, 2, 2.5)
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Generic MT5 chart; lookback default 500 bars; any TF via PERIOD_CURRENT
why_new_for_mis: Objective body–wick alphabet replaces subjective candle labels with a stable symbolic sensor stream MIS can tokenize and scan.
quote: each candle is transformed into a deterministic symbol using predefined quantitative rules. Bullish and bearish candle structures are paired into symbolic forms such as A/a, H/h, E/e, G/g, and D

mechanism: CheckBullishPattern/CheckBearishPattern concatenate CandleType(shift+1)+CandleType(shift) and match against the P(4,2)=12 ordered pairs from {A,H,E,G} and {a,h,e,g} (AH,AE,… / ah,ae,…). OnCalculate runs once per new bar over a configurable lookback, Print/Alert on hits—price action as short symbolic sequences.
data_needed: CandleType codes for adjacent bars; fixed 12+12 pattern dictionaries; lookback
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Chart symbol with lookback=500 demo; bar-close scan

mechanism: PermCalculator counts P(n,r)=n!/(n−r)! without repetition and n^r with repetition; PermGenerator backtracks GetKPermutations / PermuteWithRepetition over bull set AHEGD and bear set ahegd for length p, exports paired pattern lists to patterns.txt for offline scoring and later signal matching.
data_needed: Equal-length bull/bear alphabets; pattern length p; with/without-repetition mode; file export
